title: Can You Solve These Kid Riddles?
hook: Only 1% of Adults Solve These 3 Kid Riddles!
script: Only 1% of adults solve these 3 kid riddles! Ready? Riddle one: What has cities but no houses? A map! Two: What has an eye but cannot see? A needle! Three: What is full of holes yet holds water? A sponge! Did YOU solve these 3 kid riddles?
comment: How many of these kid riddles did you solve?
description:
Test your brain with these surprisingly tricky kid riddles! Can you beat the 1% and solve all three? Challenge your friends!
#Riddles #QuizTime #BrainTeaser
